quote: Projectile.as:8  internal static var GRAVITY:Number = 3;  ||  EnemyArcher.as:277  var velA:Number = Projectile.GRAVITY * Math.abs(targetX - fireX) / 0.866;  ||  :281  var velYa:Number = (targetY - fireY - 0.5 * Projectile.GRAVITY * t * t) / t;  ||  :286  velYa += Math.random() * 8 - 4;  ||  ArrowProjectile.as:53  rotation = Math.atan(velY / velX) * 57.2727 + 180;  :56  velY += GRAVITY;
text: The live archer AI firing rule and the global projectile gravity constant are both held, closing the ledger's 'arrow arc physics' item outright. Projectile.GRAVITY = 3 (px/frame^2), applied as velY += GRAVITY every update. EnemyArcher.fireArrow() fires from (mcs.x, mcs.y-60) at a target sampled at (target.mcs.x, target.mcs.y-60), solving a fixed-45-degree-ish ballistic: velA = sqrt(GRAVITY*|dx|/0.866), velXa = velA*0.866, t = |dx|/velXa, velYa = (dy - 0.5*GRAVITY*t*t)/t, sign-flipped when firing left, then a uniform aim jitter velYa += Math.random()*8 - 4. Above level 50 a coin flip sets Damage.LAUNCH_KNOCKDOWN on the arrow. EnemyGoblinThrower uses the identical solve; EnemyKanjiGuardian divides by 0.866/3 for a flatter arc.

text: The v0.717 wilderness place-name generator is fully held and deterministic. NameGenerator.getPlaceName(territoryID) special-cases two territory ids, then splits territoryID into territoryx = ID>>12 & 0xFFF and territoryy = ID & 0xFFF; if territoryx % 137 < 26 it indexes the 677-entry place table at (territoryx%137)*26 + (territoryy%26); otherwise it concatenates namestarting[78] + nameending[37] under RNG(territoryID*2), giving 2,886 possible names. 'Chika'+'da' = Chikada, 'Ka'+'kuchi' = Kakuchi, 'Kasu'+'ta' = Kasuta, 'Moto'+'harah' = Motoharah, 'Yasu'+'oka' = Yasuoka, 'Atsu'+'zawa' = Atsuzawa. I re-implemented the shipped LCG and confirmed by brute force.
